analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported a strong Q2 FY27 with revenue growing 16.0% year-on-year, driven by healthy demand across key markets and contributions from recent launches. Gross margin and EBITDA margin expanded significantly due to a favorable product mix and operational efficiencies. Management highlighted ongoing capacity expansions, a robust CDMO pick-up, and healthy cash generation supporting a strong balance sheet. Management reported a positive start to Q1 FY '27 with revenues of INR640 crores, representing 6.4% year-on-year growth driven by a strong 26.5% increase in the non-GPL business which offset a 52.6% decline in GPL due to inventory rationalization. Profitability improved significantly with gross margins rising 510 bps to 60.2% and EBITDA margins increasing 650 bps to 36.6%, supported by a favorable product mix, newer launches, and operational efficiencies.

guidance.claim: The company guides for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: GPL business is expected to be flattish in FY27.
guidance.quote: GPL business is expected to be flattish in FY27, despite a significant decline in Q1FY27.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of achieving revenue growth of 10% - 12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: With a continued strong growth momentum in the non-GPL portfolio and muted growth in the GPL business, we remain confident of achieving revenue growth of 10% - 12% in FY27, while sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30%–32% range.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2FY27 revenue grew by 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27.
demand_outlook.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization, registering a decline of 52.6% year-on-year in Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Chronic therapies accounted for 74% of the top line in Q1 FY '27, with CVS and CNS anchoring growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Turning to the therapeutic mix, CVS and CNS continued to anchor growth during the quarter, together contributing 58% to the top line. Overall, chronic therapies accounted for 74% of top line in Q1 FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Ankleshwar has a planned brownfield addition of approximately 100KL capacity in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur greenfield Phase 1 intermediate block and backward integration of approximately 340 KL is slated for Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 - ~340 KL (Intermediate block and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur greenfield Phase 2 API / Pharma block of approximately 125 KL is slated for Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 - ~125 KL (API / Pharma block) Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur greenfield Phase 3 planned addition of approximately 535 KL is slated for FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 3 - Planned addition of ~535 KL FY29

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur is progressing as planned and will be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction at the Taloja R&D center has begun in earnest and will happen on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores, and the company expects to incur approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores. We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Brownfield capacity addition of approximately 160 KL is planned at Dahej in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API Dahej Planned addition of ~160KL Capacity Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 greenfield expansion at Solapur for approximately 350 KL is scheduled for Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 - ~350 KL (API and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Gross Margin was 64.4%, up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT Margin was 28.9%, up 390 bps QoQ and 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved to 60.2%, an increase of 510 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6%, supported by enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 36.6%, up 220 bps QoQ and 650 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Margins for the quarter were at 36.6%, up 220 bps QoQ & 650 bps YoY, signifying better operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for the quarter were at 25.0%, up 140 bps QoQ and 480 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margins for the quarter were at 25.0% up 140 bps QoQ & 480 bps YoY.

orders_capacity.claim: Cumulative DMF and CEP filings reached 630 across major markets as of September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: DMF/CEP filings continue across major markets in Q2FY27, taking the total cumulative filings to 630 as on 30th September 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline remains robust with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid representing a $82 billion total addressable market.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the high-potent API portfolio, 13 products have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages of development, and 9 are progressing through lab development stages.
orders_capacity.quote: Of these 13 products have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages of development and the remaining 9 products are progressing through lab development stages.

orders_capacity.claim: Several CDMO projects are in advanced stages of discussions.
orders_capacity.quote: Several projects are in advanced stage of discussions.

orders_capacity.claim: DMF/CEP filings reached a total cumulative count of 617 as of June 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: DMF/CEP filings continue across major markets in Q1FY27, taking the total cumulative filings to 617 as on 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: ROICE expanded to approximately 34% underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to remain a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management remains watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: So while we remain watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment, the strength of our business fundamentals gives us confidence in our growth outlook.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties which could cause actual outcomes to differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements are based on current expectations, forecasts and assumptions that are subject to risks and uncertainties which could cause actual outcomes and results to differ materially from these statements.

management_commitments.claim: Management expresses confidence in sustaining momentum and delivering consistent growth based on ongoing capacity expansion and development pipeline.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

management_commitments.claim: Solapur is going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.
